stories.title: Google to Allow One-Tap Android App Installs From Approved Third-Party Stores Outside U.S.
stories.description: Google will let approved third-party Android stores offer one-tap installs and background updates outside the US, subject to malware scanning.

stories.title: Researcher Reveals How Logic Bugs Alone Cracked Microsoft Edge in $175,000 Pwn2Own Win
stories.description: Microsoft Edge logic flaws enabled universal XSS, sandbox escape, and code execution without memory corruption in a patched Pwn2Own exploit.

stories.title: PHP2Shell Attack Roots 25 Servers, Breaches U.S. Government-Affiliated Network
stories.description: A suspected China-linked actor used an AI-assisted PHP2Shell exploit chain to root 25 servers and target Active Directory in a U.S. govt environment.

stories.title: Ukrainian Hive and Nefilim Ransomware Affiliate Gets 70 Months in US Prison
stories.description: Artem Stryzhak was sentenced to 70 months in prison after pleading guilty to using Nefilim ransomware in attacks.
